title: Mountain Run
_bible: STYLE & CHARACTER BIBLE (paste into every image_prompt): hero = a glossy crimson 1990s GT race car, matte carbon accents; world = fog-wrapped alpine pass at dawn; look = anamorphic 35mm, teal-and-amber grade, Kodak Portra warmth, realistic analog film grain, 16:9. Repeat verbatim for cross-frame consistency (the image endpoint has no reference input).
